description: Default Renovate config for RCTab repositories

customManagers.description: The Poetry that CI and Docker images install, pinned so a new Poetry release can't change CI results unannounced

packageRules.description: Automerge low-risk updates once CI passes
One PR for runtime minor and patch updates. Runtime majors get their own PRs because they may need code changes. Later rules move dev, CI, internal and Python updates into their own groups
One PR for dev tooling, majors included
Automerge major updates of dev tools too: CI catches anything they break, and runtime majors still wait for a human
One PR for CI and pre-commit tooling, majors included

The Poetry that CI and Docker images install joins the CI tooling PR. This doesn't change the Poetry that Renovate relocks with (the version in each poetry.lock header) or a project's requires-poetry minimum, which are bumped by hand
Our own libraries: update together, as soon as we tag a release, and let a human merge
Python version bumps are deliberate: own PR, approved from the Dependency Dashboard, never automerged
Docker Hub's floating tags (postgres:18, python:3.15) have no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would leave them pending forever. These updates need dashboard approval anyway
